source.how: Composer's real builder (loaded by path, standard library only) writes the user_report from synthetic raw normalise reports; Director's own offline world (real router, real worker client, real template store, scripted Composer transport) uploads, stores and serves it. scripts/fixtures/template-admission-report/capture-admission-report.py regenerates these files. No network, no key, no model call, no deck text. The job rows are Director's test world (slide_count 1, a fixed clock and ids), not a real deck's.

big-deck.what: 450 slides: the strip is bounded (quiet slide rows left out), totals count every slide

admission_report.headline: Template ready: 450 slides. 3603 of 3604 pieces of text are editable; 1 is left out and listed below. 5415 of 5420 elements are editable. 2 are kept as pictures. 3 are left out. 17 changes are listed below.

On slide 200, 2 elements that lie outside the slide are left out.
On slide 413, 2 shapes reaching far past the slide edge are kept as pictures (not editable).
On slides 6, 43, 80, 117 and 8 more, 12 dashed outlines are drawn solid.
